core_obligations: Choose a surjective smooth presentation V -> Y from a representable stack in groupoids (definition of algebraic stack).
The 2-fibre product U = V x_Y X is representable by an algebraic space (base change by the space-representable lemma).
The projection U -> X is representable by algebraic spaces, smooth and surjective (property transfers).
Conclude X is an algebraic stack by the smooth-surjective lemma.
proof_roadmap: Presentation choice; space representability; property transfers; final application.
